source.author: cic
source.text: Non enim ea me adnumerare lectori putavi oportere, sed tam- quam appendere.
source.text_original: Non enim ea me adnumerare lectori putavi oportere, sed tam- quam appendere.
source.text_english: For I thought that those things ought not to be merely counted out to the reader, but, as it were, weighed out.
